name: Maadi Law, LLC
verdict: The biggest movement this week is a 35.56% drop in Google Business Profile actions alongside a 20% decline in leads week-over-week, while spend also pulled back 13.65%, suggesting a budget reduction or pacing slowdown is suppressing overall lead volume. On a positive note, Snapchat and Instagram surged 175% and 163.6% respectively, though Meta remains the sole source of all 38 tracked leads against Google Ads' 3 conversions on $1,884.38 in spend.

performance.verdict: Six overdue SOW milestones, not budget, are the primary risk to revenue.

findings.text: 5 SOW milestones were due by 2026-08-01 — Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, Meta Retargeting — all remain unconfirmed 3+ months later.
Shoot 1 milestone due 2026-09-30 shows no completed event; 33 days overdue with no creative production confirmed.
Google Ads spent $1,884.38 over 28 days and returned only 3 conversions — a blended CPL of $628 vs Meta's $48.34 (38 leads on $1,837). Google efficiency is critically misaligned.

GHL shows 110 opportunities created but 0 won, 0 appointments, and opportunity value of $0 over 28 days — leads are entering the pipeline but not progressing, signaling an intake/CRM leak, not an ads problem.

3-day spend signal (Oct 30–Nov 1: $121.86, $53.63, $129.75 avg ~$101.75/day) is down ~21% vs prior 3 days (Oct 27–29: $115.31, $143.61, $101.60 avg ~$120.17/day), driven by a near-zero Google spend day on Oct 31 ($29.98).

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue Aug-01 SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; no paid scale until tracking and intake stack confirmed live.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones due by 2026-08-01 — Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting — show no completion event as of 2026-11-02, over 3 months late. Nacer (Ops) must provide a status update and revised completion dates for each. Success is confirmed when each milestone has a logged completion event in the project tracker. Resolution expected by 2026-11-07.

suggestions.text: Shift up to $15/day from Google Ads to Meta; Google's 28-day CPL is $628 vs Meta's $48.34 — confirmed underperformance.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads produced 3 conversions on $1,884.38 (CPL $628) vs Meta's 38 leads on $1,837 (CPL $48.34) over the same 28-day window. Reduce Google daily budget by $15/day and apply that amount to Meta's active lead campaigns. Success check: Google CPL moves below $300 or Meta lead volume increases week-over-week without CPL rising above $60. Re-evaluate by 2026-11-09.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL pipeline: 110 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments — intake is not converting leads; fix routing or follow-up cadence.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 110 opportunities created with $0 value, 0 appointments booked, and 0 cases won over 28 days, despite 38 tracked leads entering the system. This is an intake process failure, not an ads problem. Nacer to audit stage-by-stage drop-off and confirm speed-to-lead under 5 minutes and follow-up cadence are active per SOW. Success is at least 1 appointment booked and opportunity stage movement visible in GHL by 2026-11-09.
